data.comment: Implementation notes: (1) Removed the dead Ralph/.ralph.json config system and the --model/--phase1-model CLI flags; model selection now resolves to DEFAULT_MODEL, with explicit *model* still honoured for direct callers. (2) The work item listed only skill/audit/tests/test_audit_runner_core.py, but the repo-root tests/test_audit_runner_core.py also asserted the removed CLI flags; it was updated too (4 assertions/tests adjusted). (3) Pre-existing dead helper _normalize_model_source() was left in place (out of scope; never had callers). (4) The full-suite gate required raised host test-concurrency (TEST_MAX_CONCURRENCY=8) because the shared 2-slot semaphore was saturated by concurrent agents — environmental only. (5) Full suite green at pushed commit 7660e441.
